notes.title: Devlog 1: Spark Ignited — Welcome to the Shattered Realms
notes.content:
«Why make a game? Because I craved something brutally honest: a dark fantasy where every sword swing could be your last. Wishlist LOST REALMS and join my descent into madness.»  

☠️ Who Am I & Why Should You Care?  
Let’s get this straight: I’m not a studio. I’m a guy who spent 2000+ hours in games like Darkest Dungeon and Escape from Tarkov, screaming at the screen: “What if we combined THIS with THAT?!”.  

This is LOST REALMS — my love letter to:  
  
 The despair of permadeath (RIP, Stoneshard characters).  
 The adrenaline of extraction shooters (but with swords, because guns are for cowards).  
 Gothic architecture that makes you want to redecorate… in blood.  
  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537038/b308520ce0a4b4bb7010fa4b7163623f85d57fb8.png
🌑 The Pitch: “Dark Fantasy That Punishes Like a Jilted Lover”  
Imagine:  
You wake up on a floating island. The sky? Shattered. The gods? Rotting. Your mission? Scavenge ruins, fight horrors, and maybe make it back to your Sanctuary alive.  

  
 Death is a Tax Collector — Lose everything but your grit (and trauma).  
 Your Sanctuary is Your Soul — Rebuild it; unlock hybrid classes (Rogue-Mage-Necromancer? Go nuts).  
 NPCs Will Betray You — That cheerful blacksmith? He’s 73% Redditor.  
  

🔍 Peeking Behind the Curtain: What’s Done?  
The World:  
  
 Veiled Woods — A forest so dense, even the shadows get lost.  
 Drowned Citadel — Think "Atlantis meets Silent Hill" with ✨godrays✨.  
 Ashen Wastes — Where sandstorms erase bones… and your progress.  
  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537038/c1705a0ed43f134f491ce0584953a495ccfa25e0.png
The Combat:  
  
 Weight Matters — Daggers = fast but weak, Greatswords = slow but "Oh gods, my spine!".  
 Ranged Combat = Self-Harm — Powerful Shot? 100% eaten by wolves (balance!).  
  

Enemies (So Far):  
  
 Skeletons that are made of bones. Yes, really. 
 Wolves (awoooo)
 Spiders
 Ghoul
 The Warden of Roots — Feather-covered Menace (weakness: poetry readings).  
  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537038/c0298d177648bd1a4c4eb0b6946a90595f252719.png
🚧 Current State of the Madness  
  
 Demo Target: soon (soon enough) (Pray for me).  
 Progress: 65% — Core combat works, 2/3 zones modeled, 1 boss that haunts my dreams.  
 Mod Support Planned — Replace spiders with cupcakes? You do you.  
  

🤔 Community Corner: Let’s Get Controversial  
Question 1: What’s worse than losing all loot on death?  
  
 A) Your character develops PTSD and refuses to leave the Sanctuary.  
 B) Enemies steal your gear and mock you in broken English.  
  

Question 2: What creature should we add next?  
  
 A) A mimic that pretends to be an exit portal.  
 B) Pablo.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537038/ff30f2b5dfb7b078a4654011f721b12327797ce3.png
  
Comment your war crimes below.  

🔮 Why Wishlist?  
Because this isn’t just a game — it’s a test. Will you cling to hope? Or let the Shattered Realms break you?  

👉 WISHLIST LOST REALMS ON STEAM

P.S. Follow for Devlog #2: “Why I Regret Adding Permadeath” (and cat pics from crunch time).
